bullets.text: Privacy Concerns With AI—DuckDuckGo's survey reveals many users share personal information with AI chatbots, highlighting a lack of understanding about data usage and privacy implications.
Smartphone Prices Rise Permanently—Analysts predict that smartphone prices will continue to increase, making low-cost devices harder to find and impacting budget-conscious consumers.
Amazon Expands Nvidia Partnership—Amazon triples its order of Nvidia GPU chips to meet surging demand for AI capabilities, indicating strong growth in AI infrastructure needs.
Siri AI Waitlist for Users—Apple will implement a waitlist for new Siri AI features in iOS 27, potentially delaying access for users and managing server capacity.
Instinct's Rapid Growth—AI startup Instinct raises $350 million, achieving a $2.5 billion valuation, reflecting the high investor interest in innovative AI solutions.
